entry.summary: Since 23 April 2026, non-visa nationals arriving from outside the Common Travel Area need a UK ETA, which the UK runs for Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man. Arriving from the UK, the UK ETA already covers it.
entry.max_stay: Up to 6 months as a visitor
entry.pre_arrival: Apply at gov.uk/eta/apply or the UK ETA app at least three working days before travel; £20 (about A$38 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = £0.5258).

sources.title: Introduction of ETA for non-visa nationals travelling to Jersey (31 March 2026)
sources.supports: ETA from 23 April 2026, run by the UK for Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man
